{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Greece|Greek cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Fish|Fish]] 

This is the Catsoulis family recipe from the Greek island of Kythera.

==Ingredients==

* [[Cookbook:Flathead|Flathead]] fillets
* Plain [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]], seasoned with [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] and [[Cookbook:pepper|pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 cloves fresh [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 sprig fresh [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]] leaves, chopped
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] brown [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] fillets in seasoned flour until coated.
# Heat oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]], and add garlic and rosemary leaves. Cook slightly, then add the fish.
# When the fish is cooked, remove from pan and drain off excess oil.
# There should be enough flour in the pan (fallen from the fish) to make the sauce. If there isn’t, add a tablespoon of flour to the pan juices and brown. Add vinegar (and stand back). Add a little water and stir to make gravy.
# Spoon gravy over fish and serve with a Greek salad.
